subject: website
name: Remix IDE
summary: Remix IDE, open source (Apache-2.0). It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads Font Awesome's kit script from kit.fontawesome.com, third-party code with no integrity hash that the provider can change at any time. It also embeds an X timeline, and fetches compiler lists and plugin data from several hosts.

connections.name: Font Awesome kit (kit.fontawesome.com)
connections.note: A script loaded when the page opens, without an integrity hash.

connections.name: X timeline embed (platform.twitter.com)
connections.note: A visible embed on the home tab.

connections.name: Solidity compilers (binaries.soliditylang.org)
